A monastery is a place where people are sent to for [[Rehabilitation]] after committing a crime<ref name=":0">[[Reacting to the Meaning Crisis]] episode 40, around 1:05:00</ref>. It is an authoritarian imposition of the goopd life onto someone. <ref name=":0" /> It is not just acting under weak compassion, it is in fact much more forceful than any punitive system because it is expecting a fundamental change to someone rather than merely making their life worse so they can rationally improve as a punitive system is.<ref name=":0" />
